Cómo comprar por Alibaba paso a paso para importar desde China Comprar por Alibaba es más fácil de lo que muchos creen, pero no funciona igual que comprar en AliExpress, Temu o Shein. En Alibaba debes buscar el producto, comparar proveedores, filtrar por verificados, revisar años de experiencia, reseñas y reputación. Luego debes escribirle al proveedor, negociar precio, cantidad, calidad y cotizar el envío por DHL, UPS o FedEx si vas a traer por avión. No te dejes presionar por un link de pago: primero valida bien la información y paga solo cuando tengas todo claro. Guarda este video si quieres aprender a comprar por Alibaba y compártelo con alguien que todavía cree que esta plataforma es demasiado complicada. #Alibaba #ImportarDeChina #ComprasEnAlibaba #EcommerceColombia #AcademiaDeImportadores

⚠️THINGS TO KNOW!!⚠️ This set from AF would cost you $5,500 without tax or shipping or floaters so basically well over $6,000.  Secondly not all Alibaba manufacturers are good and you can definitely get scammed if not careful.  Many Alibaba companies will try and hit you with tariffs fee wich is a scam. Or make you wait 6+ months. So you must find a proper dealer or use same one as me.  Dont listen to them wheel sales companies saying Alibaba doesnt have good wheels. AF, JTX, KG1, Liberty forged all buy there blanks from these companies in china and sometimes even have them cut the wheels for them.  My contact from Alibaba has amazing quality and prices, I got lucky finding them and orders take 6-10 weeks from starting your coversation till there at your door. You can have any custom cut pattern or logo, powder coated or whatever your heart desires.  These wheels also balance out perfectly fine. And if you see anyone posting about Alibaba in a negative way who purchased wheels its as simple as they did not buy from a good company. That website has every company in china under the sun and not all of them are good just like in America not all brands make quality products.  Hate me all you want but I saved money for the same wheel you bought from name brand for more then double the price.  Lastly Ive bought a few sets from them and these are 22x12 -44 offset concave AF notches with custom floaters polished front and back of wheel shipped to my door for $2,520….you really cant beat that price #alibaba #wheels #diesel #forged #22x12
